2026-27 Free Agent Contract Predictions

Every free agent: my model’s length and price, a 1-10 year slider, and my pick

Published

October 30, 2026

players = transpose(raw).map(d => ({
  ...d,
  aav: d3.range(1, 11).map(L => d[`aav_${L}y`]),
  total: d3.range(1, 11).map(L => d[`total_${L}y`])
}))
fmtM = x => x == null ? "" : "$" + (x / 1e6).toFixed(1) + "M"
tiers = ["star", "regular", "role player", "depth"]

All figures are my model’s predictions, made before free agency opened, in 2027 dollars. Pick Model to see the length my model thinks most likely, or My pick to see the length I chose; either way the price at that length comes from the same 1-10 year slider. Tap a player to see his whole slider.

Previous club is the team he played for in 2026. I’m predicting contracts, not where players sign.

Players shaded yellow have a 2027 option or opt-out that is not yet decided. Each option call is my model’s read, not a forecast. Cheap club options are often exercised more than my model’s price suggests. Players whose option kept them under contract are hidden unless you tick the box, and are graded separately.

The 2026-27 qualifying offer is $23.15M (MLB Trade Rumors).

viewof view = Inputs.radio(["Model", "My pick"], {value: "Model", label: "Length"})
viewof q = Inputs.search(players, {placeholder: "Search a name", label: "Search"})
viewof tierSel = Inputs.checkbox(tiers, {value: tiers, label: "Tier"})
viewof roleSel = Inputs.select(["All", "Hitter", "Starter", "Reliever"], {label: "Role"})
viewof posSel = Inputs.select(["All", ...Array.from(new Set(players.map(d => d.position))).sort()], {label: "Position"})
viewof optSel = Inputs.checkbox(["Hide players with a pending option", "Show players kept off the market by an option"], {label: "Options"})
viewof qoSel = Inputs.select(["All", "QO-eligible", "QO received"], {label: "Qualifying offer"})
viewof ageMax = Inputs.range([d3.min(players, d => d.age_2027), d3.max(players, d => d.age_2027)], {step: 1, value: d3.max(players, d => d.age_2027), label: "Age up to"})
rows = q.filter(d => tierSel.includes(d.tier) && (roleSel == "All" || d.role == roleSel) &&
                     (posSel == "All" || d.position == posSel) && d.age_2027 <= ageMax &&
                     (d.default_view || optSel.includes("Show players kept off the market by an option")) &&
                     !(d.option_pending && optSel.includes("Hide players with a pending option")) &&
                     (qoSel == "All" || d.contract_status.startsWith(qoSel)))
  .map(d => {
    const L = view == "Model" ? d.model_years : d.my_years
    return {Player: d.player, "Previous club": d.last_club, Pos: d.position, Age: d.age_2027, Tier: d.tier,
            Years: L, AAV: d.aav[L - 1], Total: d.total[L - 1], Option: d.option_text, _p: d}
  })
viewof picked = {
  const t = Inputs.table(rows, {
    columns: ["Player", "Previous club", "Pos", "Age", "Tier", "Years", "AAV", "Total", "Option"],
    format: {AAV: fmtM, Total: fmtM,
             Player: (x, i, data) => { const p = data[i]._p; return p.option_text ? html`<span class=${p.default_view ? "opt" : "opt-off"}>${x}</span>` : x },
             Option: (x, i, data) => x ? html`<span class=${data[i]._p.default_view ? "opt" : "opt-off"}>${x}</span>` : ""},
    sort: "Total", reverse: true, multiple: false, rows: 14, layout: "auto",
    width: {Player: 150, "Previous club": 140, Option: 300}
  })
  // Tapping anywhere on a row selects it (not just its radio button).
  t.addEventListener("click", e => {
    const tr = e.target.closest("tbody tr")
    if (tr && e.target.tagName !== "INPUT") tr.querySelector("input")?.click()
  })
  return t
}
md`${rows.length} of ${players.length} free agents shown.`
sel = picked ? picked._p : null
card = {
  if (!sel) return html`<p class="note">Tap a player in the table to see his 1-10 year slider.</p>`
  const ser = d3.range(10).map(i => ({years: i + 1, aav: sel.aav[i] / 1e6, total: sel.total[i] / 1e6}))
  const marks = [{years: sel.model_years, who: "My model"}, {years: sel.my_years, who: "My pick"}]
  const w = Math.min(width, 520)
  const plot = (key, label) => Plot.plot({
    width: w, height: 230, marginLeft: 52,
    x: {label: "Contract length (years)", ticks: 10, domain: [0.5, 10.5]},
    y: {label: label, grid: true, zero: true},
    color: {domain: ["My model", "My pick"], range: ["#2b6cb0", "#c05621"], legend: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.line(ser, {x: "years", y: key, stroke: "#888"}),
      Plot.dot(ser, {x: "years", y: key, fill: "#888", r: 2.5}),
      Plot.dot(marks.map(m => ({...m, v: ser[m.years - 1][key]})), {x: "years", y: "v", stroke: "who", r: 7, strokeWidth: 2.5}),
      Plot.text(marks.filter((m, i) => i == 0 || m.years != marks[0].years).map(m => ({...m, v: ser[m.years - 1][key]})),
                {x: "years", y: "v", text: m => `${m.who}: ${m.years} yr`, dy: -14, fill: "who"})
    ]
  })
  return html`<div class="player-card">
    <h3>${sel.player} <span class="note">${sel.position}, age ${sel.age_2027} in 2027, ${sel.tier}</span></h3>
    <div class="note">Previous club: ${sel.last_club || "none in 2026"}</div>
    <div class="status">Contract status: <b>${sel.contract_status}</b>${sel.contract_status == "Not QO-eligible" ? html` <span class="note">(${sel.status_reason})</span>` : ""}</div>
    ${sel.model_estimate ? html`<div class="status-est">Model estimate: ${sel.model_estimate} (expected guarantee ${fmtM(sel.qo_total)}, ${fmtM(sel.qo_aav)} a year, vs one year at $23.15M, if he receives a qualifying offer)</div>` : ""}
    ${/QO/.test(sel.contract_status) && sel.contract_status != "Not QO-eligible" ? html`<div class="status-est">Most players decline the qualifying offer; only a few accept each year.</div>` : ""}
    ${sel.option_text ? html`<div class="optline"><b>${sel.option_text}</b>${sel.grading && sel.grading != "graded" ? html`<br><span class="note">${sel.grading}</span>` : ""}<br><span class="note">This is my model's read, not a forecast. Club options compare its 1-year price with the option salary minus the buyout; player options and opt-outs compare his expected market total (plus any buyout) with the money the option keeps; within 15% is a close call. Cheap club options are often exercised more than my model's price suggests.</span></div>` : ""}
    <div class="kv">
      <span>My model: <b>${sel.model_years} yr, ${fmtM(sel.aav[sel.model_years - 1])}/yr</b> (chance of exactly that length ${(100 * sel.p_model_years).toFixed(0)}%; 80% range of AAV with the length uncertain: ${fmtM(sel.model_aav_low)} to ${fmtM(sel.model_aav_high)})</span>
      <span>My pick: <b>${sel.my_years} yr, ${fmtM(sel.aav[sel.my_years - 1])}/yr</b>${sel.my_note ? " (" + sel.my_note + ")" : ""}</span>
      <span>Projected WAR 2027: <b>${sel.projected_war_2027}</b></span>
      <span>Comparable past deals: median ${sel.comparable_median_years ?? "n/a"} yr, longest ${sel.longest_comparable_deal ?? "n/a"} yr</span>
      ${sel.raise_flag && sel.raise_flag != "inside" ? html`<span>Raise check: ${sel.raise_flag}</span>` : ""}
    </div>
    ${plot("aav", "AAV ($M)")}
    ${plot("total", "Total ($M)")}
    <p class="note">The slider keeps my model's price at its length and scales other lengths by his projected value over those years (aging only): AAV falls and the total rises with each added year. Lengths beyond any comparable past deal are estimates.</p>
  </div>`
}

Price vs projected WAR

What my model pays a free agent at a chosen length, by age, projected WAR next season and position group. The curve runs across WAR at the age and length you pick.

pv = transpose(pvw)
viewof agePick = Inputs.range([25, 38], {step: 1, value: 29, label: "Age"})
viewof warPick = Inputs.range([0.5, 6], {step: 0.25, value: 3, label: "Projected WAR"})
viewof lenPick = Inputs.range([1, 10], {step: 1, value: 3, label: "Contract length (years)"})
viewof groupPick = Inputs.select(["Starter", "Reliever", "Catcher", "Middle infield", "Center field", "Corner OF", "1B/DH"], {value: "Starter", label: "Position group"})
curve = pv.filter(d => d.group == groupPick && d.age == agePick).map(d => {
  const r = d[`r_${lenPick}`]
  return {...d, a: d.aav * r, lo: d.aav_p10 * r, hi: d.aav_p90 * r, total: d.aav * r * lenPick,
          beyond: d.longest == null || lenPick > d.longest, over: d.aav_p90 * r > d.record}
})
shown = {
  let seg = 0, prev = null
  return curve.filter(d => !d.over).map(d => { if (prev !== null && d.beyond != prev) seg++; prev = d.beyond; return {...d, seg} })
}
hit = curve.find(d => Math.abs(d.war - warPick) < 1e-6)
html`<p class="price-read ${hit && hit.beyond && !hit.over ? "price-est" : ""}">${!hit ? "No reliever projects that high; try 2.5 WAR or less."
  : hit.over ? `Past the record AAV of ${fmtM(hit.record)}, so my model doesn't price it here.`
  : html`<b>${fmtM(hit.a)}</b> a year for ${lenPick} year${lenPick > 1 ? "s" : ""}, <b>${fmtM(hit.total)}</b> total <span class="note">(range of the average price: ${fmtM(hit.lo)} to ${fmtM(hit.hi)} a year)</span>`}</p>
  ${hit && hit.beyond && !hit.over ? html`<p class="note">Longer than comparable players have signed (${hit.longest == null ? "no comparable deals" : "longest " + hit.longest + " years"}): treat it as an estimate.</p>` : ""}`
Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(width, 640), height: 300, marginLeft: 52,
  x: {label: "Projected WAR next season", domain: [0.5, 6]}, y: {label: `Predicted AAV, ${lenPick}-year deal ($M)`, grid: true, zero: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(shown, {x: "war", y1: d => d.lo / 1e6, y2: d => d.hi / 1e6, fill: "#2b6cb0", fillOpacity: 0.15}),
    Plot.line(shown.filter(d => !d.beyond), {x: "war", y: d => d.a / 1e6, z: "seg", stroke: "#2b6cb0", strokeWidth: 2}),
    Plot.line(shown.filter(d => d.beyond), {x: "war", y: d => d.a / 1e6, z: "seg", stroke: "#999", strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
    Plot.ruleX([warPick], {stroke: "#999", strokeDasharray: "3,3"}),
    Plot.dot(hit && !hit.over ? [hit] : [], {x: "war", y: d => d.a / 1e6, fill: hit && hit.beyond ? "#999" : "#c05621", r: 6})
  ]
})

The price starts from my model at 3 years. Other lengths scale it by projected WAR over those years with the aging curve, as in the player sliders: AAV falls and the total rises with each added year. Grey dashes mark lengths longer than comparable players have signed. The band is uncertainty in the average price, not the spread between deals, which is much wider. Built from my model, fit on 11 winters of free-agent contracts (2015-16 to 2025-26), in 2027 dollars. Predictions are for planning and discussion, not a guarantee of any deal.
